title: D · Fill the resume and letter with owned text blocks
summary: Current design recommendation: one coordinated initial writing request, then independent block repairs. Separate ownership does not mean a model call for every block.
body:
Current design recommendation: one coordinated initial writing request, then independent block repairs. Separate ownership does not mean a model call for every block.

Separate initial section writers remain a possible later experiment, not a proven improvement.

Python copies name/contact/employers/titles/dates/education and assembles skills.

Writer chooses wording, structure and emphasis within supplied facts. It does not change employers, invent metrics or grade itself.

Save JSON and PDF previews early; the user can inspect the draft while checks are pending.
